discussion when there is one.

## Decision evidence

For consequential choices, follow the
[governing engineering principles](https://github.com/chriscollins500/ccollins-civiscribe/blob/main/docs/dev/engineering_principles.md#decision-evidence).
Describe the goal, actual constraints, strongest plausible alternatives,
investigation, implemented experiments, and evaluation against a baseline.
Explain the concrete evidence or tradeoff behind a conventional selection.
Separate demonstrated capability, theoretical support, and speculative
assumptions, and state the limits of any claimed improvement.

## How it was checked

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. Describe any
relevant checks you could not run.

Use the Checks tab to review validation, dependency review, and website results
against this PR. Link any related work on the public roadmap. The contributor
workflow and protected publication steps are described in the
[repository maintenance guide](https://github.com/chriscollins500/ccollins-civiscribe/blob/main/docs/repository_maintenance.md#merge-verification-rollout).

For a metadata or saving change, a small synthetic regression example helps
show which prompts, resources, image samples, or filenames should result.

## User-facing details

Explain any effect on saved metadata, filenames, image quality, settings,
dependencies, or documentation. Include screenshots when they clarify a UI
change. Review all attachments for private content before posting.

Edit shared guide sources in `docs/wiki`; the publishing workflow updates the
wiki and website together. Update relevant support, roadmap, security, or
